subject: Quick look at the updated invoice
body:
Hi Daniel,

Hope your week is going well. I was going through the outstanding paperwork from the facilities team and noticed that the invoice for the Westbridge clinic is still showing as pending on our side.

I've attached the updated copy as Invoice_Westbridge_Nov24.pdf. There were a couple of adjustments to the department allocation, so this should replace the version I sent over last week. Could you have a look when you get a chance and let me know if everything looks right?

If you aren't the right person to review these anymore, no worries, just let me know who I should send it to. We're trying to get the November records closed out before Friday, so it'd be great to have this sorted sometime tomorrow.

Thanks so much,
Mara
Finance Operations
Merefield Health Group

subject: November statement available
body:
Your November account statement is ready for review.

The statement includes recent account activity, scheduled transactions and any applicable service charges through November 23, 2026.

Please open the attached document, Alderwick_Statement_November.pdf, to review the details. We recommend checking the transaction summary before the next statement cycle. If you have recently updated your account preferences, the document will reflect the latest available information.

No action is required if the statement is accurate. If you identify a discrepancy, please retain the document for reference and contact your usual account representative.

Thank you for banking with Alderwick Bank.

Document Services
Alderwick Bank

subject: Annual account documentation for review
body:
Dear Ms. Whitmore,

As part of Bellmont Bank's routine annual account review, we have prepared an updated copy of your account documentation for the current reporting period.

Please find the attached file, Whitmore_Annual_Account_Review.pdf, and review the information at your earliest convenience. The document contains a summary of your account classifications, applicable service arrangements, and the contact details currently held on file.

Should any information require correction, please reply to this correspondence with a brief description of the discrepancy. Our client records team will coordinate any necessary updates with the appropriate department.

We would appreciate receiving your acknowledgment by November 30, 2026, so that our records may be finalized within the scheduled review period.

Yours sincerely,
Client Records Administration
Bellmont Bank
